text_en: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the sabbath; his disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
text_cn: 那时，耶稣在安息日由麦田中经过：他的门徒饿了，开始掐麦穗吃。

text_en: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to him, “Look, your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on the sabbath. ”
text_cn: 法利塞人一见，便对他说：“看，你的门徒作安息日不许作的事。”

text_en: He said to them, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们没有念过：达味与那些同他在一起的人，饥饿时，作了什么？

text_en: He entered the house of God and ate the bread of the Presence, which it was not lawful for him or his companions to eat, but only for the priests.
text_cn: 他怎样进了天主的殿，吃了供饼？这供饼原是不准他吃，也不准同他在一起的人吃，而是只许司祭吃的。

text_en: Or have you not read in the law that on the sabbath the priests in the temple break the sabbath and yet are guiltless?
text_cn: 或者你们在法律上没有念过：安息日，司祭在圣殿内违犯了安息日，也不算为罪过吗？

text_en: I tell you, something greater than the temple is here.
text_cn: 但我告诉你们：这里有比圣殿更大的。

text_en: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy and not sacrifice, ’ you would not have condemned the guiltless.
text_cn: 假如你们了解‘我喜欢仁爱胜过祭献’是什么，你们就决不会判断无罪的人了，

text_en: For the Son of Man is lord of the sabbath. ”
text_cn: 因为人子是安息日的主。”

text_en: He left that place and entered their synagogue;
text_cn: 耶稣就离开那里，进了他们的会堂。

text_en: a man was there with a withered hand, and they asked him, “Is it lawful to cure on the sabbath? ” so that they might accuse him.
text_cn: 看，那里有一个人，他的一只手干枯了，他们问耶稣说：“安息日许不许治病？”为的是要控告他。

text_en: He said to them, “Suppose one of you has only one sheep and it falls into a pit on the sabbath; will you not lay hold of it and lift it out?
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们中谁有一只羊，假如安息日掉在坑里，而不把它抓住，拉上来呢？

text_en: How much more valuable is a human being than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the sabbath. ”
text_cn: 人比羊贵重得多了！所以，安息日是许可行善的。”

text_en: Then he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand. ” He stretched it out, and it was restored, as sound as the other.
text_cn: 于是给那人说：“伸出你的手来！”那人一伸出来，手就完好如初，同另一只一样。

text_en: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how to destroy him.
text_cn: 法利塞人出去，商讨怎样陷害耶稣，怎样除灭他。

text_en: When Jesus became aware of this, he departed. Many crowds followed him, and he cured all of them,
text_cn: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里；有许多人跟随他，他都治好了他们；

text_en: and he ordered them not to make him known.
text_cn: 且警告他们不要将他传扬出去：

text_en: This was to fulfill what had been spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
text_cn: 这是为应验那藉依撒意亚先知所说的话：

text_en: “Here is my servant, whom I have chosen, my beloved, with whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit upon him, and he will proclaim justice to the Gentiles.
text_cn: “看，我的仆人，他是我所拣选，我所钟爱的；他是我心灵所喜悦的；我要使我的神住在他身上，他必向外邦人传布真道。

text_en: He will not wrangle or cry aloud, nor will anyone hear his voice in the streets.
text_cn: 他不争辩，也不喧嚷，在街市上没有人听到他的声音：

text_en: He will not break a bruised reed or quench a smoldering wick until he brings justice to victory.
text_cn: 已压破的芦苇，他不折断；将熄灭的灯心，他不吹灭，直到他使真道胜利。

text_en: And in his name the Gentiles will hope. ”
text_cn: 外邦人将要期待他的名字。”

text_en: Then they brought to him a demoniac who was blind and mute; and he cured him, so that the one who had been mute could speak and see.
text_cn: 那时，有人给他领来一个又瞎又哑的附魔人，耶稣治好了他，以致这哑巴能说话，也能看见。

text_en: All the crowds were amazed and said, “Can this be the Son of David? ”
text_cn: 群众都惊奇说：“莫非这人是达味之子吗？”

text_en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “It is only by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons, that this fellow casts out the demons. ”
text_cn: 法利塞人听了，说：“这人驱魔，无非是仗赖魔王贝耳则步。”

text_en: He knew what they were thinking and said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and no city or house divided against itself will stand.
text_cn: 耶稣知道了他们的意念，就对他们说：“凡一国自相纷争，必成废墟；凡一城或一家自相纷争，必不得存立。

text_en: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then will his kingdom stand?
text_cn: 如果撒殚驱逐撒殚，是自相纷争，那么他的国如何能存立呢？

text_en: If I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your own exorcists cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
text_cn: 如果我仗赖贝耳则步驱魔，你们子弟是仗赖谁驱魔？为此，他们将是你们的裁判者。

text_en: But if it is by the Spirit of God that I cast out demons, then the kingdom of God has come to you.
text_cn: 如果我仗赖天主的神驱魔，那么，天主的国已来到你们中间了。

text_en: Or how can one enter a strong man’s house and plunder his property, without first tying up the strong man? Then indeed the house can be plundered.
text_cn: 或者，一个人如何能进入一个壮士的家，抢他的家具？除非先把壮士捆住，然后才抢他的家。

text_en: Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
text_cn: 不随同我的，就是反对我；不与我收集的，就是分散。

text_en: Therefore I tell you, people will be forgiven for every sin and blasphemy, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
text_cn: 为此，我告诉你们：一切罪过和亵渎，人都可得赦免；但是亵渎圣神的罪，必不得赦免。

text_en: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.
text_cn: 凡出言干犯人子的，可得赦免；但出言干犯圣神的，在今世及来世，都不得赦免。”

text_en: “Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad; for the tree is known by its fruit.
text_cn: “你们或者说树好，它的果子也好；或者说树坏，它的果子也坏，因为由果子可认出树来。

text_en: You brood of vipers! How can you speak good things, when you are evil? For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
text_cn: 毒蛇的种类哪！你们既是恶的，怎能说出善来？因为心里充满什么，口里就说什么。

text_en: The good person brings good things out of a good treasure, and the evil person brings evil things out of an evil treasure.
text_cn: 善人从善库里，取出善来；恶人从恶库里，取出恶来。

text_en: I tell you, on the day of judgment you will have to give an account for every careless word you utter;
text_cn: 但我告诉你们：人所说的每句废话，在审判之日，都要交账，

text_en: for by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned. ”
text_cn: 因为凭你的话，要定你为义人；也凭你的话，要定你为罪人。”

text_en: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to him, “Teacher, we wish to see a sign from you. ”
text_cn: 那时，有几个经师和法利塞人对耶稣说：“师傅，我们愿意你显示一个征兆给我们看。”

text_en: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation asks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
text_cn: 他回答他们说：“邪恶淫乱的世代要求征兆，但除了约纳先知的征兆外，必不给它其他的征兆。

text_en: For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the sea monster, so for three days and three nights the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth.
text_cn: 有如约纳曾在大鱼腹中三天三夜；同样，人子也要在地里三天三夜。

text_en: The people of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the proclamation of Jonah, and see, something greater than Jonah is here!
text_cn: 尼尼微人在审判时，将同这一代人起来，定他们的罪，因为尼尼微人因了约纳的宣讲而悔改了；看，这里有一位大于约纳的！

text_en: The queen of the South will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon, and see, something greater than Solomon is here!
text_cn: 南方的女王，在审判时，将同这一代人起来，而定他们的罪，因为她从地极而来，听撒罗满的智慧；看，这里有一位大于撒罗满的！

text_en: “When the unclean spirit has gone out of a person, it wanders through waterless regions looking for a resting place, but it finds none.
text_cn: 邪魔由人身上出来以后，走遍干旱之地，寻找一个安息之所，却没有寻着；

text_en: Then it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came. ’ When it comes, it finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
text_cn: 他于是说：我要回到我出来的那间屋里去。他来到后，见里面空着，打扫干净，装饰整齐，

text_en: Then it goes and brings along seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and live there; and the last state of that person is worse than the first. So will it be also with this evil generation. ”
text_cn: 就去，另外带了七个比他更恶的魔鬼来，进去，住在那里；那人末后的处境就比以前的更坏了。对这邪恶的世代也必是这样。”

text_en: While he was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and his brothers were standing outside, wanting to speak to him.
text_cn: 耶稣还同群众说话的时候，看，他的母亲和他的兄弟，站在外边，想要同他说话。

text_en: Someone told him, “Look, your mother and your brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you. ”
text_cn: 有人告诉他说：“看！你的母亲同你的兄弟，站在外边，想要同你说话。”

text_en: But to the one who had told him this, Jesus replied, “Who is my mother, and who are my brothers? ”
text_cn: 他却回答那告诉他的人说：“谁是我的母亲？谁是我的兄弟？”

text_en: And pointing to his disciples, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!
text_cn: 遂伸出他的手，指着自己的门徒说：“看！我的母亲，我的兄弟！

text_en: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother. ”
text_cn: 不拘谁遵行我在天之父的意旨，他就是我的兄弟、姊妹和母亲。”
